info.name: E-Commerce API — Req 4
info.description: Import the local environment and run login requests first. Req 4 folder covers real order creation, safe replay, private-channel auth and admin approval. Mail is explicitly MOCK locally. WebSocket instructions and worker stop/restart commands: postman/README.md. Run requests deliberately: catalog admin requests mutate data.
